message: SLFA 9.1(g) (Has the Borrower failed at any time to maintain a Cumulative Net Loss Ratio for any period, other than the period beginning Sept. 1, 2021 and ending Aug. 31, 2022, of less than or equal to 2.75%, and for the period beginning Sept. 1, 2021 and ending Aug. 31, 2022, of less than or equal to 3.50%?): no master covenant definition is in force for 2025-12 (none recorded, or its first version starts after the period end), so the report's threshold 0.035 was not checked. Record the definition in master data.
